llm.summary: This appears to be a purpose-built Walmart/Dataify collection skill, with a caution that its auto-invocation scope should be reviewed before use.

dimensions.detail: The described capability, submitting Walmart scraping or collection tasks to Dataify, fits the stated purpose of the skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The scanner-reported implicit invocation setting is broad for an external task-submission workflow, so users should ensure the agent asks before submitting jobs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No evidence supplied indicates a deceptive installer, hidden payload, or privilege-escalating install behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Use of a Dataify API token and outbound submissions is expected for this integration, but Walmart inputs and task parameters will be sent to a third-party service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No evidence supplied shows background persistence, credential harvesting, privilege escalation, destructive actions, or unrelated local data access.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to submit Walmart collection tasks through Dataify. Keep the Dataify API token private, review the exact Walmart query or URL before any submission, and prefer explicit confirmation before creating tasks so accidental loosely related requests do not consume quota or send unintended inputs to Dataify.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] unexpected: The reported concern about broad implicit invocation is a real usability and control concern for an external task-submission skill, but it does not by itself show deception, exfiltration, or purpose-mismatched behavior.
